items.name: Soul of the Bed of Chaos

actions.description: Light the first bonfire in the Undead Asylum courtyard.
Talk to Oscar in the Asylum and receive the Estus Flask.
Defeat the Asylum Demon and leave through the great doors.
Ride the giant crow to Firelink Shrine in Lordran.
Talk to Petrus of Thorolund at Firelink until you join the Way of White (or start as Knight/Cleric).
Take the aqueduct from Firelink into the Undead Burg.
Buy the Residence Key from the Male Undead Merchant in the Burg.
Defeat the Taurus Demon on the Burg tower wall.
Cut the Hellkite Dragon’s tail on the Burg bridge for the Drake Sword.
Kill the Hellkite Dragon on the Burg bridge (optional later).
Pass under the Hellkite to the Sunlight Altar gate and open it.
Reach 25 Faith offline (or lower the requirement later with prior White Phantom clears — this route assumes 25 Faith).
Pray at the broken Sunlight Altar statue to join Warrior of Sunlight.
Loot the Basement Key from the corpse at the foot of the Parish church stairs.
Take the Mystery Key downstairs in the Parish church.
Defeat the Bell Gargoyles on the Parish roof.
Climb the Parish tower and ring the Bell of Awakening.
Buy the Crest of Artorias from Andre under the Parish.
Defeat the Moonlight Butterfly in Darkroot Garden.
Take the Divine Ember behind the Moonlight Butterfly tower.
Use the Basement Key to enter Lower Undead Burg.
Open Griggs’s house with the Residence Key in Lower Burg.
Defeat the Capra Demon in Lower Burg.
Open the Depths with the Key to the Depths.
Take the Large Ember from the Depths butcher’s chest.
Break Laurentius out of the barrel in the Depths.
Cut the Gaping Dragon’s tail for the Dragon King Greataxe.
Defeat the Gaping Dragon.
Open Blighttown from the Depths with the Blighttown Key.
Defeat Chaos Witch Quelaag.
Ring the second Bell of Awakening in Quelaag’s Domain.
Use the illusory wall after Quelaag, talk to Eingyi, then join the Daughter of Chaos covenant.
Gather 30 Humanity (rats, baby skeletons, or consumables) for Chaos Servant rank.
Offer 30 Humanity to the Chaos Servant for Chaos Storm.
Reach the Valley of Drakes (from New Londo key path or Darkroot Basin).
Loot Astora’s Straight Sword beside the undead dragon.
Loot the Dragon Crest Shield by the undead dragon’s head.
From Blighttown swamp, open the Great Hollow illusory walls and descend to Ash Lake.
Talk to the Stone Dragon at Ash Lake to join Path of the Dragon.
Cut the Stone Dragon’s tail for the Dragon Greatsword (it will not aggro).
Enter Sen’s Fortress after both bells are rung.
Jump the Sen’s Fortress roof gap and take the Cage Key from the tower.
Free Big Hat Logan from the cage in Sen’s Fortress.
Defeat the Iron Golem at the top of Sen’s Fortress.
Ride the bat-wing demons into Anor Londo.
Defeat Ornstein first, then Smough, for Ornstein’s soul (NG path for Dragonslayer Spear).
Receive the Lordvessel from Gwynevere after Ornstein & Smough.
Talk to Gwynevere to join Princess’s Guard (do this before killing her).
Kill Gwynevere to darken Anor Londo (needed for Gwyndolin access / Dark Anor Londo).
Equip the Darkmoon Seance Ring at the Darkmoon tomb and join Blade of the Darkmoon before fighting Gwyndolin.
Loot the Darkmoon Seance Ring from the Catacombs coffin near the first Necromancer.
Defeat Dark Sun Gwyndolin in Dark Anor Londo.
Return to the Undead Asylum via the Parish elevator crow nest and take the Peculiar Doll.
Use the Peculiar Doll on the Anor Londo painting to enter the Painted World.
Cut Crossbreed Priscilla’s tail for the Priscilla Dagger.
Defeat Crossbreed Priscilla.
Open the Crest of Artorias door in Darkroot.
Talk to Alvina behind the Crest door and join the Forest Hunter covenant.
Defeat Great Grey Wolf Sif in Darkroot Garden.
Defeat Pinwheel in the Catacombs and take the Rite of Kindling.
In the Catacombs coffin with an Eye of Death, join Gravelord Servant (before killing Nito).
Loot Eyes of Death in the Catacombs (near the first Titanite Demon / patches area).
Before Frampt: defeat Four Kings, talk to Kaathe in the Abyss, place the Lordvessel with him (Darkwraith path).
Open New Londo, fetch the Key to the Seal from Ingward after the Lordvessel, and drain the ruins.
Equip the Covenant of Artorias and defeat the Four Kings in the Abyss.
Talk to Darkstalker Kaathe after Four Kings (before placing the Lordvessel with Frampt) and join Darkwraith.
Place the Lordvessel with Kingseeker Frampt at Firelink Altar (locks out Kaathe Darkwraith join).
Receive the Dark Hand when joining Darkwraith (or farm Darkwraiths in New Londo).
After the Lordvessel is placed, enter the Duke’s Archives from Anor Londo.
Free Big Hat Logan from the Duke’s Archives prison before killing Seath.
Cut Seath’s tail in the Crystal Cave for the Moonlight Greatsword.
Defeat Seath the Scaleless in the Crystal Cave.
Defeat Gravelord Nito in the Tomb of the Giants.
Defeat the Bed of Chaos in Lost Izalith.
Place the four Lord Souls in the Lordvessel at Firelink Altar.
Defeat Gwyn, Lord of Cinder in the Kiln.
Light the Final Bonfire to Link the Fire (ends the run / enters NG+).
Leave through the Kiln fog without lighting the fire for the Dark Lord ending (ends the run / enters NG+).
Give the Large Ember (and Very Large Ember later) to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Standard path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Very Large Ember from New Londo after draining the water.
Give the Crystal Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Crystal path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Crystal Ember from the Duke’s Archives.
Ascend a +10 weapon to Lightning +5 at the Giant Blacksmith (no ember).
Give the Large Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Raw path (materials assumed gathered).
Give the Large Magic Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Magic path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Large Magic Ember from the Duke’s Archives balcony after freeing Logan’s first cell route.
Give the Enchanted Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Enchanted path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Enchanted Ember from the Darkroot basin chest among Mushroom people.
Give the Divine Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Divine path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Large Divine Ember from the Tomb of the Giants.
Give the Dark Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Occult path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Dark Ember from the Painted World annex.
Give the Large Flame Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Fire path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Large Flame Ember from the Demon Ruins.
Give the Chaos Flame Ember to the appropriate blacksmith.
Reinforce a weapon to the max Chaos path (materials assumed gathered).
Take the Chaos Flame Ember behind the Demon Firesage / Centipede Demon path.
Forge Moonlight Butterfly Horn at the Giant Blacksmith (+5 spear/rapier).
Forge Crystal Ring Shield at the Giant Blacksmith (+5 shield).
Forge Greatsword of Artorias at the Giant Blacksmith (broken straight sword / hilt).
Forge Greatsword of Artorias (Cursed) at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 sword/dagger).
Forge Greatshield of Artorias at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 shield).
Forge Chaos Blade at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 katana).
Forge Quelaag's Furysword at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 curved sword).
Forge Golem Axe at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 axe).
Forge Dragon Bone Fist at the Giant Blacksmith (caestus).
Forge Dragonslayer Spear at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 spear).
Forge Lifehunt Scythe at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 halberd/whip).
Forge Darkmoon Bow at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 bow).
Forge Tin Darkmoon Catalyst at the Giant Blacksmith (catalyst).
Forge Great Lord Greatsword at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 dagger/sword).
In a later run, defeat Smough first then Ornstein for Smough’s soul.
Forge Smough's Hammer at the Giant Blacksmith (+10 hammer).
Farm sword Silver Knights in Anor Londo.
Farm spear Silver Knights in Anor Londo.
Farm Silver Knights for their shield.
Farm sword Black Knights in the Kiln.
Farm greatsword Black Knights in the Kiln.
Farm greataxe Black Knights in the Kiln.
Farm halberd Black Knights in the Kiln.
Farm Black Knights for their shield.
Farm Stone Knights in Darkroot for the Stone Greatsword.
Farm Stone Knights in Darkroot for the Stone Greatshield.
Farm Channelers (Parish / Depths / Archives) for the Trident.
Kill invading Paladin Leeroy in the Tomb of the Giants for Grant.
Kill invading Paladin Leeroy in the Tomb of the Giants for Sanctus.
Return to the Asylum and kill hollow Oscar for the Crest Shield.
Buy the Crescent Axe from Patches (forgive him) or loot it if you kill him.
Buy the Demon’s Spear from Shiva of the East (Forest Hunter merchant in Blighttown).
Buy the Giant’s Halberd from the Giant Blacksmith in Anor Londo.
Loot Velka’s Rapier in the Painted World annex.
Receive the Gravelord Sword when joining Gravelord Servant.
Kill the Asylum Demon in the cell courtyard (NG+ or strong start) for the Demon’s Great Hammer.
Buy Soul Arrow from Griggs or Rickert.
Buy Great Soul Arrow from Griggs.
Buy Heavy Soul Arrow from Griggs.
Buy Great Heavy Soul Arrow from Griggs.
Buy Homing Soulmass from Logan at Firelink.
Buy Homing Crystal Soulmass from Logan in the Archives.
Buy Soul Spear from Logan.
Buy Crystal Soul Spear from Logan in the Archives.
Buy Magic Weapon from Griggs.
Loot Great Magic Weapon in Anor Londo.
Buy Crystal Magic Weapon from Logan.
Buy Magic Shield from Griggs.
Loot Strong Magic Shield in the Archives.
Buy Aural Decoy from Griggs.
Loot Hush in Sen’s Fortress.
Buy Fall Control from Griggs.
Buy Hidden Body from Dusk of Oolacile.
Buy Cast Light from Dusk of Oolacile.
Buy Repair from Dusk of Oolacile.
Loot Chameleon in the Painted World.
Loot Remedy in Blighttown.
Buy Resist Curse from Ingward.
After Seath, find hollow Logan in the Archives crystal cave room for White Dragon Breath.
Buy Fireball from Laurentius.
Buy Fire Orb from Laurentius.
Buy Combustion from Laurentius.
Buy Great Combustion from Quelana.
Buy Firestorm from Quelana.
Buy Fire Tempest from Quelana or loot after killing her sister path.
Buy Fire Whip from Quelana.
Loot Poison Mist in Blighttown swamp.
Buy Toxic Mist from Eingyi.
Loot Acid Surge in the Painted World.
Buy Iron Flesh from Laurentius.
Buy Flash Sweat from Laurentius.
Loot Power Within near the Cragspider in Blighttown.
Buy Undead Rapport from Quelana.
Receive Great Chaos Fireball when joining Chaos Servant.
Loot Chaos Fire Whip in Lost Izalith.
Buy Heal from Petrus or Rhea.
Buy Great Heal Excerpt from Petrus.
Buy Great Heal from Rhea in the Parish (save her in Tomb of Giants first — do her quest early).
Buy Soothing Sunlight from Rhea (conservative: finish her inventory before more bosses).
Save Rhea in the Tomb of Giants pit for Replenishment.
Buy Bountiful Sunlight from Rhea.
Buy Force from Petrus or Rhea.
Buy Wrath of the Gods from Rhea.
Receive Emit Force from Siegmeyer’s questline reward path / buy alternatives as needed.
Buy Magic Barrier from Rhea.
Loot Great Magic Barrier in Ash Lake’s hollow trunk.
Buy Homeward from Petrus.
Buy Seek Guidance from Petrus.
Buy Karmic Justice from Oswald after ringing the Parish bell.
Loot Vow of Silence in the Painted World.
Loot Tranquil Walk of Peace in the Catacombs.
Receive Lightning Spear when joining Warrior of Sunlight.
Offer 10 Sunlight Medals at the Sunlight Altar for Great Lightning Spear.
Offer the Soul of Gwyn at the Sunlight Altar for Sunlight Spear (forces a later run for Great Lord Greatsword if both are needed).
Reach Darkmoon covenant rank for Darkmoon Blade (Souvenirs of Reprisal — farm the Painting Guardians / Dark Anor Londo offline sources as available).
Receive Gravelord Sword Dance when joining Gravelord Servant.
Offer Eyes of Death to rank up Gravelord Servant for Gravelord Greatsword Dance.
Loot Sunlight Blade after defeating Gwyndolin.
